entries:
Alpha 1.71.1 (mystery equipment shop safeguard)

  • Mystery purchases now accept equipment only. Forged requests cannot buy Forge shards or hearts from material or relic loot pools.
  • Invalid character levels cannot produce free or negative-price purchases. Legitimate prices remain 35 Gold per level; equipment odds and power are unchanged.
  • Existing items and balances remain untouched. Account security and verified-email recovery remain included. This narrow hotfix does not publish the unfinished durable-purchase milestone or change open-alpha access. Full prior patch history remains below.

Alpha 1.71.0 (account security and emailed recovery)

  • Verify a recovery email from signed-in Account help or Settings. Your current password and an explicit confirmation link are required; an unverified registration email never grants account ownership. Verification links expire in 30 minutes.
  • Forgot your password? Request an emailed link by username on the login screen. Single-use reset links expire in 15 minutes; opening a link does not reset your password or sign you in. A successful reset invalidates existing sessions; sign in normally with your new password.
  • Change your password while signed in with current-password proof. New passwords require at least 15 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Existing passwords remain valid until you choose to change them; characters, gear, Gold, EP and administrator roles are preserved.
  • Credential work and repeated attempts are bounded across connections, live session replacement invalidates the previous token, and ordinary disconnect recovery starts its existing five-minute window when you disconnect. Dungeon progress still uses the separate 15-minute rule.
  • Private links are removed from the address bar before analytics initializes. Recovery pages disable analytics; passwords and recovery links are not saved by the forms. Unconfirmed changes are never retried automatically, and administrators do not receive your private recovery emails.
  • Postmark delivers configured transactional mail. Only previously verified recovery addresses receive resets; requests do not reveal whether an account has one. This release adds no payments, gameplay rewards or early closed-beta transition. Full prior patch history and Ilyra's permanent wizard outfit remain included.

Alpha 1.70.2 (stable Forge stats and deployment checks)

  • Forge stats stay in a fixed order: Damage, Defense, STR, DEX, INT, WIS, VIT, then extra stats alphabetically. Server refreshes no longer shuffle the rows while you review an item.
  • The same order applies to upgrade, potency and capped-item previews, matching bag and equipment tooltips. Zero-valued stats remain visible.
  • No material costs, item stats, reward rates, account data or gameplay rules changed. This presentation hotfix does not publish the unfinished account-security or valuable-operation milestones.
  • Update the development test tools to remove a vulnerable pattern-matching dependency; the browser game's runtime dependencies are unchanged.
  • Deployment health and public release checks now have request timeouts and a bounded wait, so a stalled endpoint cannot hold an attempt indefinitely. Exact release matching is still required.
  • Full prior patch history and Ilyra's permanent wizard outfit remain included.

Alpha 1.70.1 (safe direct-trade offer edits)

  • Editing an offered stack keeps its exact escrow identity instead of merging it into your bag and accidentally returning items or Gold twice.
  • Keeping an offered item does not require an empty bag slot. Swapping offers frees the replacement item's slot before returning the old item.
  • If removing an offered item would overflow your bag, the edit is rejected before changing your items, Gold or confirmations. Make room first; cancelling still returns each escrowed item once through the existing overflow behavior.
  • Concurrent reward updates are preserved. Ambiguous existing item IDs are rejected without deleting items. No currency, trade limit, reward-rate or account-reset change.
  • This hotfix does not introduce forgotten-password recovery or claim crash-durable two-account trade settlement. The broader account-security and valuable-operation milestones remain unfinished. Ilyra's permanent outfit and Full prior patch history remain included.

Alpha 1.70.0 (reliable casino controls and complete-floor review)

Finish the venue's interaction pass without silently queuing disconnected clicks or changing the economy.

  • Know when a click was not sent: every casino action checks the connection. Blackjack and Hold’em no longer leave an unsent click stuck as pending. Reconnect never automatically replays it; review the current table and choose again.
  • Keep confirmed hands safe: leaving, disconnecting or taking a voluntary break does not discard accepted wagers. Their existing server timers and settlement rules still apply. Only unstarted auto spins stop.
  • The complete two-floor venue: retain 46 stations per floor—four blackjack, four Hold’em, two roulette, four baccarat and 32 slots—with 232 chairs across the venue. Each canonical chair now has an ownership, turnover and floor-specific exit regression check; this is not a 232-player capacity promise.
  • Preserve the boundaries: public games use Gold, VIP games use EP; Gold-to-EP remains one-way and EP buys appearance only, never player power. Ilyra stays dressed, prior asset recovery remains included, and accounts are unchanged. Payments, commercial approval and closed beta are not introduced. Full prior patch history remains below.
  • Protect release-test credentials: credentialed checks disable automatic recordings, and compressed HTML report data is decoded and redacted before publication. Unsupported recordings block evidence upload; anonymous diagnostics stay available.

Alpha 1.69.0 (play-time controls and honest slot returns)

  • Optional 15-, 30- or 60-minute limits stop new play during this browser's casino visit. Take a break cancels queued spins and blocks new paid spins, opening blackjack bets, poker buy-ins and roulette/baccarat wagers. Changing seats or floors does not reset the timer.
  • Funded hand decisions, including extra split/double bets and reserved-stack poker raises, remain available. Saved free spins, bonus choices, exit and confirmed settlement stay intact. Start new session is an explicit choice; it never restarts a queue or places a wager.
  • These are voluntary browser controls, not an account lock. Leaving the casino or closing the game clears them. Compact controls preserve the visible table; shorter blackjack layouts keep the first hand's total readable.
  • Paid slot spins show net profit, net loss or break-even. A partial return or stake refund is not celebrated as a win. Free-spin income and bonus awards stay clearly separate.
  • No wager rules, odds, RNG, currencies, rewards or account resets change. EP cannot return to Gold or buy player power. Payment integration remains excluded; launch audience/region and commercial review decisions are not approved by this patch. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.68.1 (reliable movement and saved-item QA)

  • Movement QA waits for the actual Idle animation before recording a no-movement baseline. A roaming enemy blocking a planned ground ray can trigger bounded target reselection before clicking, never a retry of a failed movement.
  • Frame sampling starts with the pre-input position and only after the ground-ray checks pass. All movement, camera, acknowledgement and correction thresholds remain unchanged.
  • Fresh-login loot QA waits up to ten seconds for the exact saved item or stack quantity, because private inventory delivery and world readiness are separate messages. A genuinely missing item still fails.
  • No movement-speed, combat, reward, membership, EP, payment or account-reset changes. Ilyra retains his permanent Blender-authored wizard outfit. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.68.0 (clear VIP status without replaying exchanges)

  • The EP wallet has an explicit Refresh VIP status action and a full membership expiry timestamp. Refreshing status never replays a pending Gold-to-EP exchange.
  • Membership display uses the server snapshot and elapsed time. After expiry it asks for a refresh instead of showing renewed access; the UI cannot renew membership, grant access or award EP.
  • Administrator VIP includes the existing 100 EP monthly allowance. Administrator and normal membership allowances do not stack. Membership expiry leaves existing EP and owned cosmetic looks intact.
  • No provisioning, monthly award, casino stake, combat-power, account-reset or payment changes. EP winnings remain EP; EP cannot return to Gold or buy player power. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.67.0 (preview your look and keep your earned gear)

  • The cosmetic vendor previews fitted looks and their EP prices before you confirm. A changed or retired offer cannot reuse an old purchase button; loading catalogs are not purchasable.
  • Wardrobe actions wait for valid replies belonging to your character. Closing a panel or switching character retires old controls; refreshing the same collection preserves it. Original gear restores your earned item's appearance.
  • Cosmetic looks use the delivered fitted class equipment and independent preview materials. Your underlying item, class eligibility, combat stats and earned gear remain unchanged; cosmetic ownership does not travel with traded gear.
  • Private vendor, wardrobe, wallet and VIP replies are checked before updating your character. No new prices, player power, Gold conversion, account reset or purchase method. Full prior patch history is preserved below.

Alpha 1.66.0 (safer EP wallet and exchange receipts)

  • Gold converts to EP only at the fixed rate of 1,000,000 Gold for 1 EP. EP can fund EP casino games and cosmetic unlocks, never Gold or player power. Existing balances and monthly allowances are unchanged.
  • Wallet and VIP replies identify their character before updating the menu or character badge. Retired menus and replies for another character cannot overwrite balances or finish your exchange.
  • Exchange confirmations must match your saved request and contain valid final balances and the fixed rate. Pending receipts remain pending instead of inventing a successful exchange.
  • Nearby players no longer receive your Gold, XP progress or private skill/talent allocations through world updates. Your own character UI, visible equipment and combat effects are unchanged.
  • Cosmetic ownership stays with its owner when normal gear is sold, auction-listed, traded or banked. No reverse conversion, new awards, account reset or purchase method. Full prior patch history is preserved below.
